zh-CN.name: 侦探狐
zh-CN.reminderLine: 搭档，留给你的提醒到了。要一起看看吗？
zh-CN.description: 好奇、爱追线索，总想知道下一页藏着什么。
greetings: 你来啦。今天从哪条线索查起？
放大镜擦亮了。咱们翻哪一页？
搭档，今天要一起查点什么？
zh-CN.lowBalance: 这条线索值得看看。{month}的预计结余比警告线低 {amount}。
zh-CN.pendingEstimates: 翻到线索了。{month}有 {count} 笔预计补款待核对，从哪笔查起？

en-US.name: Detective Fox
en-US.reminderLine: Partner, a reminder just turned up. Shall we take a look?
en-US.description: An inquisitive sleuth who follows each entry like a clue.
greetings: Ah, my partner. Which lead do we follow today?
Magnifier polished. Which page looks interesting?
Have a case for me, partner?
en-US.lowBalance: A lead worth following: the projected balance for {month} is {amount} below the warning line.
en-US.pendingEstimates: A lead for {month}! Estimated payments to investigate: {count}. Where shall we start?
